studentInfo.csv.documented_source: students in courses, OULAD.names s.5 (but s.9 class distribution sums to 32,593)

studentRegistration.csv.documented_source: registration entries, OULAD.names s.5 (but s.9 implies 32,593)

notes: OULAD.names s.5 lists 32,953 students/registrations, but its own s.9 class distribution (Distinction 3,024 + Fail 7,052 + Pass 12,361 + Withdrawn 10,156) sums to 32,593 -- which is exactly the row count of both studentInfo.csv and studentRegistration.csv in the release. Verdict: 32,953 in s.5 is a documentation typo; the files match the documentation's own class distribution.

Some secondary sources quote different counts (assessments 196, vle 6,365, studentAssessment 173,740, studentVle truncated to 1,048,575 rows in spreadsheet exports). None of those match this release; the bundled documentation does, on every file.
